messages.subject: Anyone Doing Shiny Front-End Work for ONA Analysis?
parts: We're looking for possible help from folks experienced in building slick front-ends for ONA / SNA network visualization tools that leveral R.  I'd welcome contact and examples from anyone in the community doing this kind of work.  Thanks!  Brad.
